2.title: Director, Sales Strategy & Operations

6.excerpt: Data visualization experience (Tableau, Looker, or PowerBI) is highly preferred.

7.title: Sales Strategy and Operations Manager
7.excerpt: High proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for financial modeling and compensation plan simulations.

8.title: HR Infrastructure & Operations Manager
8.excerpt: Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and SQL.
